marking.create.summary: Evaluate marking descriptors (text/symbol/arrow) as annotation descriptors or gated emboss/engrave geometry recipes with source association, occupancy bounds and feasibility/position warnings; user content is preserved verbatim.

inputs.marks: Nonempty array of marking descriptors {id, kind:text|symbol|arrow, representation:annotation|emboss|engrave, position:[x,y,z], dimensions:{height,width?,stroke?}, content?, direction?, depth?, font?, source?, reference?, levelValue?, resolvedRepresentation?}.
inputs.zones: Optional array of {name?, kind?, region:{min:[x,y,z],max:[x,y,z]}} zones; optical/seal/a-surface are protected no-mark zones.
inputs.keepouts: Optional array of {name?, region:{min,max}} keepout regions.

limitations: User text/symbol content is preserved verbatim; no translation is applied.
Native emboss/engrave geometry authoring is gated and reported as notEvaluated, never silently replaced by an image.
Occupancy is an axis-aligned box from declared dimensions; real glyph extents are not measured.

marking.check.summary: Verify markings: MIN/MAX derive from the computed liquid level, arrow directions from a defined flow, no mark in an optical/seal protected zone, and no implicit geometry-to-image substitution.

inputs.marks: Nonempty array of marking descriptors (as marking.create).
inputs.levels: Optional {min, max, source?} computed liquid level; omitted levels make level-reference marks unevaluable.
inputs.flows: Optional array of {id?, direction:[x,y,z]} defined flows for arrow direction matching.
inputs.zones: Optional array of zone descriptors; optical/seal/a-surface are protected no-mark zones.
inputs.keepouts: Optional array of keepout region descriptors.
inputs.tolerance: Nonnegative length, default 0 mm, for MIN/MAX level matching.

limitations: MIN/MAX derivation is verified against declared level values, not recomputed fluid geometry.
Zone containment uses axis-aligned occupancy bounds, not native glyph outlines.
